lines.t: You stretched out your hands, scars showing your love
You washed my feet, you called me up above
I heard your voice, through the noise and the lies
Now I'm running home, no need to disguise
You tore the veil, you made a way
Your promises remain, they never fade away
I'm coming home, where your arms are wide
Yahushua, and your mercy I'll always abide
You broke all my chains, ripped heartbreak apart
You filled up my hunger, rewrote my heart
You said, come to me, I'll never turn you away
So I shout your name, your love's here to stay
I was lost and low, but you paid the price
New covenant, life bought with sacrifice
Now I run with abandon, I stand unashamed
My king, my friend, forever pray
You tore the veil, you made a way
Your promises remain every single day
I'm coming home to the arms open wide
Yahushua, in your mercy I'll always abide
God!
You tore the veil
You made a way
Your promises remain
Every single day
I'm coming home
To the arms open wide
Yahushua
In your mercy I'll always abide
We'll be right back.
